name: Create Database Connection
description: Set up a new database connection in Db2 Intelligence Center

steps.title: Open Connections Page
steps.description: Navigate to the Connections section by clicking on 'Connections' in the main menu or settings area.

steps.title: Click Add Connection
steps.description: Click the 'Add Connection' or '+ New Connection' button to start creating a new database connection.

steps.title: Enter Connection Details
steps.description: Fill in the required connection information: Connection Name, Hostname/IP Address, Port Number, Database Name, and Authentication Type.

steps.title: Provide Credentials
steps.description: Enter your database username and password. You can optionally save these credentials for future use.

steps.title: Test Connection
steps.description: Click the 'Test Connection' button to verify that the connection details are correct and the database is accessible.

steps.title: Save Connection
steps.description: Once the connection test is successful, click 'Save' or 'Create' to save the connection. It will now appear in your connections list.
